dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Staying here feels like being in Mondstadt. The only difference is that I won't be bothered by any of my duties as one of the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Imagine bringing a bottle of finely-aged wine here and having a taste... Now, wouldn't that be bliss?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: When that time comes, let's chat as we do right now, friend.
